plain_english_policy: This bill is ceremonial; it does not create new policy or allocate funds.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support commending the Coosa Valley Resource Conservation and Development Council for receiving an award.
evidence_quotes: COMMENDING THE COOSA VALLEY RESOURCE CONSERVATION AND DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES... That the honored Coosa Valley Resource Conservation and Development Staff and Council Members ... be commended and congratulated for their outstanding achievement
